About Quantum Inu

Quantum Inu merges two viral ideas: quantum energy and the classic Inu dog coin. Its face is the star-born Shiba wrapped in glowing atom rings — a dog that exists in every timeline where memes win. This is the community's main home: contract, links, gallery, and the PFP generator in one place.

⚛️ Quantum Brand

Atom rings, nebula fur, and a core of light. Instantly recognisable in any feed, any timeline.

🐕 Inu Energy

The dog-coin formula people already love — loyal pack, big dreams, zero pretence.

🌌 Community First

Raids, art, and PFPs made by holders. Grab a PFP below and rep $QI everywhere you post.

⚛️ Launched on PQC Market

$QI wasn't launched the ordinary way. Quantum Inu launched on PQC Market, a launchpad that proves who created a token using post-quantum cryptography — so $QI's origin is attested with techniques built to survive the quantum era.

🔐 Hash-Based Signatures

WOTS / XMSS one-time signature identities secure the launch attestation — security from hash functions, not the math quantum computers break.

🌲 Merkle Trees

XMSS organizes thousands of one-time keys into a single Merkle tree root. One compact root, every launch verifiable against it.

🧾 SHA-256 Attestations

The launch record is hashed with SHA-256 and anchored via IPFS + SPL Memo — a permanent, public proof of $QI's launch that anyone can check.

Games

Play with the pack — QI games right in your browser. No downloads, no sign-ups.

🃏 QI Sticker Spellmatch

Memory match with the QI sticker pack. Flip the face-down cards and match 2 to seal the pair — seal all 8 pairs, build streaks, and chase the high score.

▶ Play Spellmatch

⚔️ QI Sticker Battle

Card-battle RPG with the QI sticker pack. Play HIT and HEAL cards against rogue stickers, survive wave after wave, and chase the high score.

▶ Play Sticker Battle

🚀 QI Space Shooter

Galaga-style space shooter. Pilot the Q-Bot, blast waves of rogue QI stickers, and catch the falling upgrades — laser, duplicates, twin blasters, and shields.

▶ Play Space Shooter

🎰 QI Slots

Magical slot machine with the QI sticker pack. Spin the enchanted reels, land pairs and triples, and cash out your credits for the high score.

▶ Play QI Slots

🧩 QI Sticker Tetris

Falling-block puzzle with the QI sticker pack. Every game deals seven fresh stickers — stack them, clear lines, and chase the high score as the speed climbs.

▶ Play Sticker Tetris

🐍 QI Sticker Snake

Classic snake with the QI sticker pack. Eat atoms to grow — every catch deals the next sticker onto your tail, so a long run parades the whole pack. Golden atoms pay bonus points.

▶ Play Sticker Snake

👾 QI Rogue Chase

Maze chase with the QI sticker pack. Eat every atom and outrun four hunters dealt fresh from the pack each run — golden atoms turn them blue and edible for a few seconds.
